mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising PAYEMS (indicating a strong labor market) and low UNRATE (< 4%) creates a 'goldilocks' zone, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of 'goldilocks' zone instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in INDPRO, signaling reduced industrial production, precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to anticipated supply chain disruptions.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 58% of instances with declining INDPRO, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always, RSAFS growth rate serves as a proxy for consumer spending trends, with positive growth predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The combination of high FEDFUNDS (> 4.5%) and low CPIAUCSL growth (< 2% YoY) indicates a monetary policy mismatch, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of mismatch instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE rises by more than 0.5pp in 2 months, signaling labor market stress, investors anticipate reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 55% of instances with rising UNRATE, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in HOUST (> 10% YoY), indicating a booming housing market, supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to the wealth effect.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of instances with surging HOUST, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
